bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH LATE TONIGHT... Combined seas 18 to 20 feet, falling to 13 to 16 feet tonight. Bar conditions severe becoming rough. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 915 AM Monday, 900 PM Monday, and 1030 AM Tuesday.
